async def simulate(*, sim, tasks, vars):
    solid = await sim.run(tasks["solid"])
    await sim.record("displacement", solid["artifacts"]["displacement"])
    await sim.record("stress", solid["artifacts"]["stressField"])
    await sim.record("reaction", solid["artifacts"]["reaction"])
    sim.release(solid["artifacts"])
    sim.release(solid["state"])
    rays = await sim.run(tasks["trace"])
    await sim.record("traceFluenceRate", rays["artifacts"]["fluenceRate"])
    await sim.record("traceRadiantFluxDensity", rays["artifacts"]["radiantFluxDensity"])
    sim.release(rays["artifacts"])
    sim.release(rays["state"])
    secondary = await sim.run(tasks["secondary"])
    await sim.record("secondaryFluenceRate", secondary["artifacts"]["fluenceRate"])
    await sim.record("secondaryRadiantFluxDensity", secondary["artifacts"]["radiantFluxDensity"])
    sim.release(secondary["artifacts"])
    sim.release(secondary["state"])

modelDefinitions.description: 구조 재료의 물리 계수. 회전 및 적층 배치는 요소 단면에서 지정한다.
modelDefinitions.conventions: SI units. Engineering Voigt strain order xx,yy,zz,xy,yz,xz. nu_ij=-epsilon_j/epsilon_i under uniaxial stress i. J2 supports small strain in solid elements only.
A separately supplied absorption model determines bulk absorption even when a complex-index model supplies nonzero k.

modelDefinitions.description: Constant complex refractive index over the Experiment frequency band.
modelDefinitions.conventions: Complex index is n - i k. Frequency is cycles per second (Hz), vacuum wavelength is c/f, and bulk absorption without a separately supplied absorption model is alpha = 4 pi k / lambda_vacuum. n and k must both be supplied, including explicit k=0 for lossless media.

modelDefinitions.equation: P(no scattering over s) = exp(-sigma s)
modelDefinitions.conventions: The coefficient determines scattering event rate per path length; angular scattering laws and anisotropy belong to solver Task configuration. Omission means no bulk scattering model.
